tokens.description: Token source globs (css/scss, DTCG json, ts objects), relative to this file. Order matters: first source of a name wins the primary value.

allow.description: Custom-property name globs never reported as unknown.

colorExact.description: ΔEOK at or below which a color match is exact (autofixable). Default 0.005.

colorClose.description: ΔEOK at or below which a color match is a confident suggestion. Default 0.03.

rules.description: CLI severity overrides by rule name (without the dscheck/ prefix).

rootSelectors.description: Selectors treated as the system root besides :root (scoped systems, e.g. ".excalidraw").
